mechanism: Service shop/catalog has .spec.selector set to {app: catalog-api} while the pods it is meant to front are labelled {app: catalog}, so the selector matches zero pods and the endpoint controller writes Endpoints shop/catalog with no subsets (endpointAddresses=0). With no backend address to DNAT to, TCP connections to its ClusterIP 10.96.96.22:8080 are rejected or dropped — "timeout or connection refused" — instead of being load-balanced to the catalog pods.
